infula.definition:
n. A sort of fillet worn by dignitaries, priests, and others
   among the ancient Romans. It was generally white.

infumated.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Infumate
a. Clouded; having a cloudy appearance.

infumation.definition: n. Act of drying in smoke.

infundibula.definition: n any of various funnel-shaped parts of the body (but especially the hypophyseal stalk)

infundibular.translation:
a. 漏斗状的
[医] 漏斗的

infundibular process.translation: [医] 漏斗突(垂体的神经部)

infundibulate.definition:
a. Having the form of a funnel; pertaining to an
   infundibulum.
infundibulate.translation: a. 似漏斗状器官的, 漏斗管的; 漏斗形

infundibuliform fascia.translation: [医] 漏斗状筋膜, 精索内筋膜(腹横筋膜随精索的突出部)

infundibulum.definition: n any of various funnel-shaped parts of the body (but especially the hypophyseal stalk)
infundibulum.translation: n. [解]漏斗状器官, 漏斗管

infundibulum of frontal sinus.translation: [医] 额窦漏斗, 额鼻管

infundibulum pulmonis.translation: [医] 肺漏斗, 肺泡小管

infundibulums.translation: n. [昆] 漏斗状器官；漏斗管

infuriate.translation:
a. 狂怒的
vt. 激怒

infuriated.definition:
v make furious
s marked by extreme anger
infuriated.translation: v. 使大怒, 激怒( infuriate的过去式和过去分词 )

infuriates.translation: v. 使大怒, 激怒( infuriate的第三人称单数 )

infuriating.definition:
v make furious
s extremely annoying or displeasing
infuriating.translation:
a. 令人大怒的
v. 使大怒, 激怒( infuriate的现在分词)

infuriatingly.translation: adv. 万分激怒地, 令人发怒地

infuriation.definition: n. a feeling of intense anger

infuscate.definition: v darken with a brownish tinge, as of insect wings
infuscate.translation: a. 略带褐色的, 被弄糊涂的

infuscated.definition: v darken with a brownish tinge, as of insect wings
infuscated.translation: a. (=infuscate)略带褐色的,被弄糊涂的

infuse.definition:
v. undergo the process of infusion
v. introduce into the body through a vein, for therapeutic purposes
infuse.translation:
vt. 注入, 使充满, 泡制, 鼓舞
vi. 泡

infused.translation: v. 灌输, 加入（一种特性）( infuse的过去式和过去分词 ); 沏（茶）, 泡（草药）

infuser.definition: n. One who, or that which, infuses.
infuser.translation: n. 注入者, 鼓吹者, 浸煮器

infuses.definition:
v teach and impress by frequent repetitions or admonitions
v fill, as with a certain quality
v undergo the process of infusion
v let sit in a liquid to extract a flavor or to cleanse
v introduce into the body through a vein, for therapeutic purposes
infuses.translation: v. 灌输, 加入（一种特性）( infuse的第三人称单数 ); 沏（茶）, 泡（草药）

infusibility.definition:
n. Capability of being infused, pouredin, or instilled.
n. Incapability or difficulty of being fused, melted, or
   dissolved; as, the infusibility of carbon.

infusible.definition:
v. Capable of being infused.
a. Not fusible; incapble or difficalt of fusion, or of
   being dissolved or melted.
infusible.translation:
a. 不熔化的, 不熔化性的
[医] 不熔的

infusing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Infuse
infusing.translation: v. 灌输, 加入（一种特性）( infuse的现在分词 ); 沏（茶）, 泡（草药）

infusion.definition:
n. a solution obtained by steeping or soaking a substance (usually in water)
n. the process of extracting certain active properties (as a drug from a plant) by steeping or soaking (usually in water)
n. (medicine) the passive introduction of a substance (a fluid or drug or electrolyte) into a vein or between tissues (as by gravitational force)
n. the act of infusing or introducing a certain modifying element or quality
infusion.translation:
n. 注入, 泡制, 注入物
[化] 浸渍; 浸泡

infusionism.definition:
n. The doctrine that the soul is preexistent to the body,
   and is infused into it at conception or birth; -- opposed to
   tradicianism and creationism.
infusionism.translation: n. [宗]灵魂投胎论,灵魂注入说

infusions.definition:
n. a solution obtained by steeping or soaking a substance (usually in water)
n. the process of extracting certain active properties (as a drug from a plant) by steeping or soaking (usually in water)
n. (medicine) the passive introduction of a substance (a fluid or drug or electrolyte) into a vein or between tissues (as by gravitational force)
infusions.translation: n. 沏或泡成的浸液（如茶等）( infusion的复数形式 ); 注入, 注入物

infusive.definition: a. Having the power of infusion; inspiring; influencing.
infusive.translation: a. 令人兴奋的, 有影响力的

infusoria.definition: n in some recent classifications, coextensive with the Ciliata: minute organisms found in decomposing infusions of organic matter

infusorial.definition:
a. Belonging to the Infusoria; composed of, or containing,
   Infusoria; as, infusorial earth.
infusorial.translation: a. [动]滴虫的, 纤毛虫的

infusorial earth.translation:
[化] 硅藻土
[医] 硅藻土

infusorian.definition: n. any member of the subclass Infusoria
infusorian.translation:
n. 纤毛虫
a. 纤毛虫的

infusorians.definition:
plural of infusorian
n. any member of the subclass Infusoria
infusorians.translation:
(infusorian 的复数) n. 纤毛虫
a. 纤毛虫的
